comment: Per-rule PSScriptAnalyzer counts the repository currently carries. The check fails when a rule goes above its number here, or when a rule absent from this file appears. Lowering a number is the point: fix findings, then lower it in the same commit.
note_write_host: 12 is the measured count before the SuppressMessageAttribute was added to the three .github/scripts files, all 12 findings being in those scripts. If the attribute takes effect the next run reports BELOW_BASELINE, and this number is then lowered to the measured value.
